record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. execute-phase merges at the gate, so a done phase with an unmerged branch means a step was missed or stopped for a human, which is a gate and belongs in Needs you.

## Counter-argument

Keeping git state out of Needs you keeps that list to store records only, and a branch kept on purpose would otherwise nag.

payload.alternatives: the phase line only, no Needs you item; phase detail only
payload.choice: The selected phase line shows its Landing branch, commits ahead of main, and merged state from read-only git; a done phase with an unmerged branch is a Merge branch Needs you item

record.subject: landing-display
